svg.text: Matching: who gets paired, and where they meet
TrainRoom runs this whenever the rider set changes (check-in, check-out, Not now, a pair ending) and on its alarm.
not met in the last 7 days*
why line: Claude, one line from shared tags, ≤ 1.5 s;
else the template "You both like ramen and film"
a GameRoom code + seat per rider
* GAMES_ONLY (D26, the demo default) ignores stops: anyone on the train can be matched and a game never ends at a stop.
* DEMO_MODE ignores "met in the last 7 days" so rehearsals can pair the same people again.
